name: application-expandable-detail-row
title: Expandable Detail Row
description: Table row that expands inline to reveal a line-item detail panel, driven by a typed rows/lineItems prop contract.
useWhen: A table row (order, invoice, transaction) has structured sub-detail that shouldn't clutter the main row.
Users need to inspect line items without leaving the table or opening a separate page/modal.
Only a few rows are typically expanded at once, keeping the table compact by default.
avoidWhen: The detail content is unrelated to a tabular row — use a plain Accordion instead of table semantics.
Most rows need to be expanded simultaneously — a flat table with all detail visible may be simpler.
The detail is substantial enough to warrant its own page or drawer — use application-drawer instead of inline expansion.
responsiveBehavior: The table scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports via its wrapping overflow container; the expanded detail row spans the full column width via colSpan regardless of screen size.
accessibility: The expand/collapse toggle is a real button with aria-expanded reflecting state and a descriptive aria-label naming the row.
The chevron icon direction changes with state, but aria-expanded is the source of truth for assistive technology.
The emphasized total line item (e.g. Shipping) is set apart with a border and bold text, not color alone.

variants.title: Expandable Detail Row
variants.description: Order table with a toggleable chevron column; the expanded row reveals a full-width detail panel listing line items and an emphasized shipping total.
accessibility: The toggle button's aria-expanded and aria-label update together so the collapsed/expanded state is always announced accurately.

variants.title: Expandable Detail Row (Dark)
variants.description: Expandable order table adapted for dark surfaces with the same toggle, detail-panel, and line-item structure.
accessibility: Detail panel background, line-item text, and the emphasized total row must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
